* '''Playtest''' ([[See You Around, Kid (Playtest)]], 12 May 2019): Playtest image, published before the set's official release (2 August 2019) and replaced before it. Players Committee card image, 12 May 2019: [[:File:V11-L-seeyouaroundkid-20190512.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/948e819/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Light/large/seeyouaroundkid.gif Holotable commit 948e819 “Fixed Dash in Rogue 12 and Getting Pretty Good at This”]), no mark. Text: “Cancel a just-deployed First Order character's game text until end of turn. OR Destiny draws during battles at sites may not be canceled this turn. OR During any draw phase, place a card from hand under Used Pile to take any one card into hand from Force Pile; reshuffle.” The same file was committed again unchanged on 1 August 2019 (Holotable commit e26d0f1 “Images part 1”). On 1 August 2019 the PC's Set 11 folder also held a file <code>thesignal.gif</code> (removed on release day) showing the Decipher card [[The Signal]]'s title and game text with this card's artwork; it is not this card's image file.
* '''Original''' ([[See You Around, Kid]], 2 August 2019): Original: the image at the set's official release (2 August 2019). Players Committee card image, 2 August 2019: [[:File:V11-L-seeyouaroundkid-20190802.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/d24ffc3/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Light/large/seeyouaroundkid.gif Holotable commit d24ffc3 “Flipped sites”]), no mark. Text: “Cancel a just-deployed First Order character's game text until end of turn. OR Destiny draws during battles at sites may not be canceled this turn. OR During any draw phase, place a card from hand under Used Pile to take any one card into hand from Force Pile; reshuffle.” '''What changed:''' re-rendered on release day with sharper graphics; same words.
*: [[File:V11-L-seeyouaroundkid-20190802-changes.png|frameless|upright=2.6|alt=Before and after]] ''Before (left) and after (right): cropped from the published images.''
* '''PC-E1''' (this page, 29 March 2023): '''First published 29 March 2023''' as the high-resolution PNG <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Light/hires/seeyouaroundkid.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/168657ac16eea2f516349595d99cda7cd8f849f3 commit 168657a]); the card-size image cited next is a later copy of the same image (a version is dated by its first publication in any format; ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026). Players Committee card image, 29 March 2023: [[:File:V11-L-seeyouaroundkid.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/168657a/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Light/hires/seeyouaroundkid.png Holotable commit 168657a “Set 11 Remastered”]), no mark. It is the current image. Text: “Cancel a just-deployed First Order character's game text until end of turn. OR Destiny draws during battles at sites may not be canceled this turn. OR During any draw phase, place a card from hand under Used Pile to take any one card into hand from Force Pile; reshuffle.” '''What changed:''' Set 11 remaster: same words; re-rendered at high resolution.
